problem_type: User-facing money assertions in either direction
symptom: User-visible copy asserted that this step was free, would spend credits, was paid, or had a known budget/amount, despite the 2026-10-08 rule that the interface must not talk about money.
direct_cause: Money wording was duplicated across renderer locale dictionaries, model display labels, desktop translations, and confirmation-card branches; the gate only covered a subset of claim directions and the renderer still projected a probe cost plan.
class_root: There was no shared invariant rejecting both zero-cost and positive-cost assertions at every user-facing locale boundary, and presentation layers still received money-only probe and checkpoint fields.
affected_population: All users viewing zh-CN or English model onboarding, model labels, generation error recovery, or asset-upload failure copy.
entry_points: desktopT translations consumed by Electron error and onboarding paths
internal_only_reason: This remediation enforces Nomi's internal copy invariant; provider prices and quotas are deliberately not asserted without a scoped source.
invariants: No user-facing copy asserts either a zero-cost outcome or a positive-cost outcome for the current step; copy states only observable actions and user choices.
Credential verification copy states the request that would be sent and asks again before sending; the key can remain saved as unverified.
Retrieval, offline processing, and blocked outbound copy describe the action/result without asserting charges, credits, budgets, or amounts.

door_reduction.why_not: The two credential-probe main-process callers remain the shared behavior boundary for request strategy and confirmation; the renderer projection and amount branch were removed. buildAnchorCheckpointCard remains the single production presentation boundary, while approvedBudget and budgetCurrency were removed from its model.

generality_proof: The same rule is enforced over every loaded zh-CN and English dictionary value plus model-display keys, with positive and zero-cost patterns. The renderer probe and checkpoint boundaries no longer expose money-only presentation fields, and desktop recovery strings use action facts.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Scans every loaded locale value and model-display key for both zero-cost and positive-cost money assertions; only explicitly reasoned upstream raw errors may be exempted.
Loads the renderer's zh-CN and English dictionaries consumed by user-facing components.
Single desktop translation table for main-process user-facing error and recovery copy.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Probe, provider onboarding, and model access copy is action-only in both locales; scanner covers all values.
Chinese display keys are scanned directly so labels such as Qwen cannot reintroduce money claims.
Generation and checkpoint copy no longer asserts a charge, budget, or amount; scanner covers both locales.
Outbound and deconstruction messages use action facts without charge assertions.
The page renders one action-fact probe message and no cost-plan branch.
The card uses the single action-fact note and no approved budget fields.

recurrence.reason: The same unsupported claim can be reintroduced through any new locale key or desktop translation entry.
same_class_scan: rg -n "免费|free|已付费|paid task|消耗.*额度|spend.*credits|预算|budget|价格|price|费用|cost" src/i18n electron/desktopStrings.ts src/ui

prevention.invariant: Every loaded user-facing locale value and model-display key is rejected when it asserts either no money or money spent for the current step.
prevention.failure_mode: The gate reports locale, key, text, and exits non-zero before merge.
prevention.strategy: Use one scanner boundary with zero-cost and positive-cost patterns, and remove obsolete renderer money projections in the same change.
prevention.exception_policy_reason: Only reasoned upstream raw errors may be exempted; NOT_MONEY is empty.

legacy_paths.rationale: Obsolete money-copy branches and renderer-only money fields were deleted; main-process request policy remains for behavior and confirmation.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: No third-party dependency controls this copy invariant.

migration: Not needed; existing keys remain stable and only their displayed text changes.
residual_risks: Provider-side pricing and quota failures may appear only in upstream raw error payloads; the scanner has no current NOT_MONEY entries and must require a reason for any future one.
The production run still stores internal budget policy for authorization, but user-facing checkpoint copy no longer renders its amount.
